svg.aria-label: deck.mdx goes through the Vite plugin, which makes one module per slide, into the Deck runtime. The runtime joins the live room over a WebSocket, and the room keeps the presenter view, the projector and the audience's phones in step: following, polls, quizzes, Q&A, reactions and the phone remote.
